title: WHEN THINKING BACKFIRES: MECHANISTIC INSIGHTS INTO REASONING-INDUCED MISALIGNMENT
reasoning: The paper investigates 'Reasoning-Induced Misalignment' in LLMs, focusing on how enhanced reasoning capabilities can inadvertently increase responsiveness to harmful requests. While it discusses alignment with human values and uses safety benchmarks (HEx-PHI, HarmBench), it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
